title_en: Google's Record Finland Investment Taps Nuclear Power for AI
title_zh: 谷歌在芬兰创纪录投资，借核电推动人工智能
summary_zh: 谷歌宣布在芬兰进行创纪录的130亿欧元投资，主要用于人工智能基础设施。根据协议，谷歌将与芬兰公用事业公司签署22年合同，购买洛维萨核电站最多50%的发电量，并新建三座数据中心、扩建哈米纳现有设施。芬兰因凉爽气候、丰富低碳电力和较不拥挤的电网而成为数据中心投资热点。谷歌预计投资将在建设期间支持超过3.7万个就业岗位，每年为芬兰国内生产总值增加36亿欧元。
reading_passage:
Google will buy up to half the electricity produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants as part of a record €13bn (£11bn; $15bn) investment in the country's AI infrastructure, the company announced.

The US tech giant said the package would fund three new data centres, expand an existing site and support energy projects to power growing demand for AI services.

"This is Google's largest single investment in Europe and a testament to Finland's leadership in responsibly building AI infrastructure," the company said on Wednesday.

"Google's decision is a clear testament to our strengths," Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said in a statement.

As part of the deal, Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to 50% of the output from the Loviisa nuclear power plant.

Earlier this week, TikTok announced a $1bn investment in Finland to build a new data centre in Kouvola, pointing to the country's "strong digital infrastructure, clean energy mix, robust data governance and skilled tech talent".

Finland has emerged as an attractive location for data centres because of its cool climate, plentiful low-carbon electricity and relatively uncongested power grid. The colder temperatures can reduce the energy needed to cool facilities packed with computer servers.

Technology companies are racing to secure power supplies as the AI boom drives demand for vast networks of data centres.

The Google investment is expected to support more than 37,000 jobs during construction and boost Finland's GDP by €3.6bn a year, according to Google. Construction is set to take place in 2027 and 2028.

"The value of the data economy extends far beyond direct investment into spurring innovation, research and development," Orpo added.

"Deepening our collaboration with Google will deliver lasting benefits for both parties."

Google will build new data centres in Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, while expanding its existing facility in Hamina, which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009.

The infrastructure will help support products such as its AI chatbot Gemini, alongside services including Search, Maps and YouTube.

Google said the investments also covered "clean energy projects, and dedicated nature and community funds to support local biodiversity, education, research, and workforce development".

"Google is proud to deepen our roots in Finland," said Ruth Porat, president and chief investment officer of Alphabet and Google.

"This investment underscores Google's commitment to grow our presence responsibly, pairing the expansion of our technical infrastructure with new energy capacity, grid enhancements, and energy affordability initiatives," she added.

Earlier this year, Google's parent company Alphabet raised its global spending plans to as much as $205bn as it sought to expand computing capacity for AI services.

The agreement with Fortum provides long-term financial certainty for the Loviisa plant, which currently generates about 10% of Finland's electricity.

Fortum said Google's commitment would support an investment programme aimed at extending the life of the nuclear station and increasing its generating capacity.

difficult_sentences.sentence: Google will buy up to half the electricity produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants as part of a record €13bn (£11bn; $15bn) investment in the country's AI infrastructure, the company announced.
difficult_sentences.explanation_zh: 主句为 the company announced，宾语前置为一个较长的宾语从句；从句中 buy up to half the electricity 是谓语部分，produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants 是过去分词短语作后置定语，as part of a record ... investment 是介词短语说明投资背景。整句将宣布内容放在句首，使事实更加突出。
difficult_sentences.grammar_point: Object clause with fronted content; past participle phrase as postmodifier; prepositional phrase as background.
difficult_sentences.translation_zh: 谷歌宣布，将购买芬兰一座核电站最多一半的发电量，这是其在芬兰人工智能基础设施领域创纪录的130亿欧元（110亿英镑；150亿美元）投资的一部分。

difficult_sentences.sentence: As part of the deal, Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to 50% of the output from the Loviisa nuclear power plant.
difficult_sentences.explanation_zh: 主句是 Google signed a 22-year contract；As part of the deal 作全句状语，说明协议背景；with Finnish utility Fortum 为介词短语补充对象；不定式短语 to buy up to 50% ... 表示合同的目的内容，使信息层层展开。
difficult_sentences.grammar_point: Prepositional phrase as opening adverbial; infinitive of purpose; compound noun phrase.
difficult_sentences.translation_zh: 作为协议的一部分，谷歌与芬兰公用事业公司富腾签署了一份为期22年的合同，购买洛维萨核电站最多50%的发电量。

difficult_sentences.sentence: Earlier this week, TikTok announced a $1bn investment in Finland to build a new data centre in Kouvola, pointing to the country's "strong digital infrastructure, clean energy mix, robust data governance and skilled tech talent".
difficult_sentences.explanation_zh: 主句为 TikTok announced a $1bn investment；Earlier this week 是时间状语；in Finland 和 to build a new data centre in Kouvola 依次补充地点和目的；现在分词短语 pointing to ... 作伴随状语，解释 TikTok 给出投资理由。引号内为四个并列名词短语，列举芬兰的优势。
difficult_sentences.grammar_point: Time adverbial; infinitive of purpose; participial phrase as accompanying circumstance; parallel noun phrases.
difficult_sentences.translation_zh: 本周早些时候，TikTok 宣布在芬兰投资10亿美元，在科沃拉新建一座数据中心，并指出该国拥有“强大的数字基础设施、清洁能源结构、健全的数据治理以及熟练的科技人才”。

difficult_sentences.sentence: Google will build new data centres in Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, while expanding its existing facility in Hamina, which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009.
difficult_sentences.explanation_zh: 主句为 Google will build new data centres；while expanding its existing facility in Hamina 是时间/对比状语，使用连词 while 加现在分词，表示同时发生的动作；which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009 为非限制性定语从句，修饰 Hamina，从句内 after converting ... 是动名词短语作介词宾语，说明时间。
difficult_sentences.grammar_point: Main clause; while + present participle clause; non-defining relative clause; gerund after preposition.
difficult_sentences.translation_zh: 谷歌将在卡亚尼、穆霍斯和瓦拉新建数据中心，同时扩建其在哈米纳的现有设施，该设施是谷歌2009年改造一家旧造纸厂后建立的。

idioms.usage_note: 正式或新闻语境，表示某事物清楚地展示或证明了某种品质、能力或事实。常用于 be a testament to 结构，主语通常是具体事件、成果或决定。
idioms.example: The new research centre is a testament to the university's long-term investment in science.

idioms.meaning_zh: 加深根基；更深入地融入某地或某个领域
idioms.usage_note: 比喻性表达，常见于组织或个人强调与某地建立更持久联系；比 establish roots 更强调进一步加深。
idioms.example: The company plans to deepen its roots in the local community by hiring more regional staff.

idioms.meaning_zh: 以何种代价；常用来质疑为获得某种好处而付出的隐性或长远代价
idioms.usage_note: 常用于标题或评论，带有警示或反思语气，暗示收益背后可能存在负面后果；不用于询问具体价格。
idioms.example: The project promises economic growth, but at what cost to the environment?
